name: When the interaction URL is fetched using an `Accept` header of `application/json`, a single JSON object containing a `protocols` map MUST be returned where each map/key is a protocol identifier and each map/value is a URL that can be used to initiate the interaction.
fullName: vcalm-test-suite:tests/3.7-InitiatingInteractions/3.7.4-InteractionProtocolsResponse.js: VCALM §3.7.4 Interaction Protocols Response > When the interaction URL is fetched using an `Accept` header of `application/json`, a single JSON object containing a `protocols` map MUST be returned where each map/key is a protocol identifier and each map/value is a URL that can be used to initiate the interaction.
